generators.note: Free first. Credits change often; check each site before planning volume.

video.use: hero shots with ingredients (up to 3 reference images), first/last frame, scene extension

video.name: Seedance 2.0
video.free: daily credits on several hosts; watermark and resolution vary by host

image.name: Gemini image (Nano Banana) in Gemini / Flow
image.use: ingredient images: character sheet, location plate, style frame

templates.label: Roblox Horror
templates.concept: Faceless investigator tests one horror-game claim per segment and shows the evidence.
templates.audience: US gamers 10–17 and their older siblings; watches Roblox horror playthroughs.

patterns: This hiding spot looks safe. Is it?

visual.source: gameplay for evidence; generated only for setup, boards, CTA

music.mood: low drone, ducked under game audio

thumbnail.rules: avatar large, one threat, 2–4 words, blue vs red

title: I Tested {n} Roblox Horror Myths
Is {claim} Actually True in {game}?
compliance: No fake results or secrets
Label AI illustrations
Name the experience and version

templates.label: Kids Story
templates.concept: Short animated bedtime or lesson story with one friendly recurring character.
templates.audience: US kids 3–7 watched with a parent. Must be set as Made for Kids in YouTube Studio (COPPA).

subject.lock: one mascot sheet; same colors, eyes and outfit every scene

music.mood: soft music box or ukulele, low volume

thumbnail.rules: character face close, bright single background, one object

title: {Character} and the {Thing} | Bedtime Story for Kids
compliance: Made for Kids flag
No scary content, no ads to kids in video
No collecting comments

templates.label: Manhwa Recap
templates.concept: Original fantasy webtoon-style story told as a recap with narrated panels.
templates.audience: US 16–30, reads webtoons, watches recap channels.

patterns: He was the weakest hunter. Then the system chose him.
She was betrayed on her wedding day. She woke up ten years earlier.

subject.lock: face, hair, outfit, weapon per character sheet

visual.source: generated panels in an original manhwa style

thumbnail.rules: one face with strong emotion, glowing eyes or aura, 2–3 words

title: Weakest Hunter Gets a Secret System | Manhwa Recap
compliance: Original stories only, no copyrighted manhwa art or plots
Label AI-generated art

templates.label: JDM Cars
templates.concept: Night-city JDM culture: builds, history and meets, told with cinematic car shots.

patterns: Why does everyone want this 90s car now?

subject.lock: body shape, color, wheels, livery; no real badges if generated

visual.source: own footage or generated cars without brand logos

motion: rolling shots parallel to the car

thumbnail.rules: car 3/4 front, night neon, one number or word

title: The 90s JDM Car Everyone Wants Now
compliance: No real trademarks on generated cars
No street-racing encouragement
Music must be licensed; phonk tracks are often Content ID'd

templates.label: Fleet Formation
templates.concept: Cinematic ships or aircraft moving in formation, with short explainers of each formation.

patterns: This formation protected a whole fleet.
Why ships never sail in a straight line.

subject.lock: ship/aircraft class, livery, count and spacing

title: Why Fleets Sail in This Exact Shape
compliance: Mark simulations as simulations
No real combat footage presented as AI

templates.label: News Brief
templates.concept: 60-second explainer of one verified US story, sourced on screen.
templates.audience: US adults 18–45 who want the gist fast.

visual.source: licensed stock, official images, charts; no AI images of real people or events

thumbnail.rules: one fact, one image, source logo-free

title: {Topic}: What Actually Changed Today
compliance: Every claim has a source and date on screen
No AI depictions of real people or events
Correct and pin errors

templates.label: Music & Live Wallpaper
templates.concept: Long ambient instrumental mixes over a slowly moving fantasy wallpaper, for studying, sleeping, gaming and reading.
templates.audience: US 16–35, students and gamers who play background music for focus or sleep; long sessions on desktop and TV.

patterns: A quiet {place} at night. Stay as long as you need.

long: music 1–3 h (original tracks or one generated bed)
short: title card with the full-length link

subject.lock: same wallpaper composition, horizon and palette for the whole video; motion only from light, weather and slow camera

visual.source: stock, uploaded or AI wallpaper + live motion (zoom, drift, rain, snow, fireflies, flicker)
visual.captions: none; small track title in a corner optional

voice.style: none in the mix; optional 5-second soft intro line

music.mood: original instrumental: lofi, ambient, fantasy, game-inspired (never real game soundtracks)
music.default: Loop Studio generator or your own uploads

thumbnail.rules: the wallpaper itself, one glowing focal point, 2–4 words like "Rainy Night Study"

title: {Mood} Music for {Activity} · 1 Hour {Place} Ambience
{Place} at Night · Relaxing Fantasy Music
compliance: Never upload real game OSTs or copyrighted tracks
Only use AI music whose license allows commercial use
Vary art, music and length per upload to stay clear of YouTube’s inauthentic (mass-produced, repetitive) content rule
Label AI-generated visuals and music
